result: I added a "Reset Health" button to the player's Inspector in `scripts/player.gd` using `@export_tool_button`, which calls a new `reset_health()` function to set health back to max_health. The button needs the script to run in the editor, so I made it a `@tool` script and stopped `_physics_process` from running there; none of this has been run, since Godot isn't installed here.
